text:
deploy-bot: Kickoff: release/2026-04-01. Orchestration order: api@2.7.1 -> runtime@4.4.0 -> console@2.0.1 -> router@3.3.0. Change window 21:45-23:45 UTC. Canary plan 5% -> 15% -> 50%.
laura: Note: console will enable header_swap flag; router needs header mapping update at canary. @tim please prepare mapping and a rollback route.
tim: Got it. I'll stage router mapping and a routing-override to stable. I'll also pace ramp at 3m increments.
rachel: Runtime has a kv-cache rekey change (rekey_threshold lowered). Recommend pinning api for 40m and extended smoke 5m at each step.
ops-bot: Reserving +3 GPUs in us-east1 for 60m starting 21:40 UTC.
deploy-bot: Wave 1 (5%) started ts=1719887777. Pin api@2.7.1 for 40m.
laura: Flipping console flag header_swap=true at 21:46:10 UTC. Verified presence in responses.

-- smoke check 5m --
rachel: Smoke: p50 mild bump, kv-hit-rate down ~3% (expected), no 5xx, token errs 0.0%. Proceeding.
tim: Applying router mapping for new header at 21:52 UTC, starting slow ramp to 15%.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 15% complete.
ops-bot: Telemetry: small tail increase in ap-south, but within tolerance.
rachel: Observability: noticing rekey churn higher than lab tests in ap-south; kv-miss up ~8% for 3m. Watching.
laura: Proposal: if kv-miss >10% for 5m or p99 > 2x baseline -> rollback. Agree?
tim: Agree. Also add: if routed fallbacks to legacy header >12% for 5m, trigger rollback and apply mapping override.

-- 6m later --
ops-bot: Alert: kv-miss in ap-south spiked to 14% sustained for 6m. p99 latency up 110% over baseline for same hosts.
rachel: Initiating rollback per criteria. Executing: unpin api, flip header_swap=false, apply router override to stable mapping.
laura: Flip done: header_swap=false at 22:10:35 UTC. Router override applied.
tim: Confirmed traffic back to stable mapping and fallback routes drained.
deploy-bot: Rollback executed. Unpinning api@2.7.1 and marking release aborted.
ops-bot: Releasing reserved GPUs at 22:15 UTC.
rachel: Filing short incident note and assigning follow-ups: investigate rekey tuning under regional load, expand smoke to 8m for kv changes, rehearsal for header mapping rollback.
laura: Thanks team. We'll re-run only after kernel/rekey tests pass and router mapping rehearsals complete.
